limitations: The first failing headed attempt wrote its report and PNGs in the app user-data directory before emitting the failure markers. The wrapper failed before collecting them, then its finally cleanup removed those four owned files; only the raw log and failed receipt remain, and no outputs were reconstructed.
The same signed rejected app and same host/bundle passed on sequential headless and headed replay, and the editor diagnostic also passed; this does not identify why the original run failed.

The diagnostic/replay runs did not edit production source or change checks/tolerances. The output-retention correction was made afterward; no export was rerun for this diagnosis and no app was published or accepted.
